ActionReferralBody.description: Body for accepting or declining a pending referral introduction. `recipient_id` is the internal profile ID of the person who will receive the introduction, and `requested_id` is the internal profile ID of the person requested in the introduction.

decline_reason.description: Optional reason supplied when declining the referral. Included in the notification email sent to the requester.
decline_reason.example: I do not know this person well enough to make an introduction.

mails.description: Optional list of profile-ID / email-address pairs. For any party whose email is not yet stored, supply their ID and address here so the database is updated before the notification is dispatched.

email.description: Email address to store against this profile.

id.description: MMT profile ID of the party whose email needs updating.

reason.description: Optional message included in the notification email (used when `decline_reason` is not supplied).

recipient_id.description: MMT profile ID of the person receiving the introduction.

requested_id.description: MMT profile ID of the person requested in the introduction.

status.description: The middleman's decision on the referral request.

ActionReferralResult.description: Returns the updated referral record together with the email addresses used for notification and the rendered LinkedIn message template.

html_template.example: Hi Jane, Scott would like to introduce you to Ola...

middleman_id.description: Internal profile ID of the middleman who responded.

requested_email.description: Email address of the person who originally requested the introduction.

status.description: The decision applied to the referral.

template.description: Rendered LinkedIn message template with placeholders substituted for recipient name, status, and the requester's name.
template.example: Hi Jane, I wanted to introduce you to Ola — agreed!

get.description: Returns a paginated list of members in the white-label directory identified by `id` (the app origin ID). The authenticated user must be a member of that directory, otherwise a 403 is returned. Each member record includes connection metadata relative to the authenticated user: whether they are directly connected (`category: 1st` or `2nd`), how many connections the member has, mutual connections across all the returned list (at the top level), blindfold status, and golden recommendations. Email and `has_email` are only populated for members the caller is directly connected to.
